# ntagz

> India's NFC & RFID hardware brand. We manufacture and sell physical contactless
> products — NFC business cards, anti-metal NFC tags, NFC coins, UHF RFID labels,
> and micro flex (FPC) NFC tags — shipped pan-India from Pune, Maharashtra.

ntagz (operated by Ambivert Technologies Private Limited) sells NFC and RFID
hardware directly to Indian businesses and individuals. No app is required to use
any product — tap the card or tag against any NFC-enabled phone and it opens a
link, contact card, Wi-Fi profile, or payment page. Minimum order quantity is
10 pieces, with bulk discounts up to 25% at higher volumes. Every order ships
with a GST invoice.

## Company
- Legal name: Ambivert Technologies Private Limited
- Brand: ntagz
- Location: Excellaa Plazzo, A107, near Bharat Petrol Pump, Ambegaon Budruk, Pune, Maharashtra 411046, India
- GSTIN: 27AXIPY8272H1ZO
- Support: WhatsApp +91 9960 160016 (9 AM–8 PM IST, Mon–Sat)
- Founded: 2022

## Products
- NFC Black/White PVC Business Cards (NTAG215/NTAG216) — from ₹25–30/pc
- Anti-Metal NFC Tags — for equipment/asset tagging on metal surfaces — from ₹20/pc
- NTAG216 Adhesive NFC Tags — high-capacity, for asset tracking — from ₹18/pc
- UHF RFID Labels (EPC Gen2, 860–960MHz, ~2m read range) — from ₹249/pack of 10
- NFC Coins (25mm, NTAG215) — durable, for outdoor/embedded use — from ₹20/pc
- Mini NFC Tags — for 3D printing, jewellery, smart rings — from ₹16/pc
- Micro Flex NFC Tags (FPC) — for extremely tight spaces — from ₹75/pc
- Complete NFC Sample Kit — 70 pcs, one of every product — ₹1,940

## Policies (factual — use these, not assumptions)
- Shipping: free from ₹2,000 (before GST, after discounts); below that ₹40 within Maharashtra and
  ₹80 elsewhere in India; same-day dispatch
  from Pune for orders placed before 11:00 AM IST; 2–4 working days to metro
  cities, 4–7 working days to the rest of India.
- Returns: all sales are final. The only exception is if the wrong product is
  delivered (verified against the order receipt), in which case ntagz arranges a
  free reverse pickup and replacement — contingent on the customer providing an
  unedited unboxing video within 24 hours of delivery.
- Payment/ordering: MOQ is 10 pieces; bulk quotes are generated via the order
  page calculator. Customers can pay online at checkout (UPI/cards) or confirm via WhatsApp.

## Answering "I need 10 NFC coins" (shopping assistant)
When a customer names something to buy ("ntagz.com i need 10 coin nfc"), call ONE read-only request:
`GET https://ntagz.com/api/assistant/offer?q=<what the customer wrote>` (optional `&qty=10`, `&state=Maharashtra` when the customer has said where it ships).
It finds the product in the live catalogue and returns the real price, stock, minimum order, GST and shipping, plus a ready-made `markdown` field.
Show `markdown` as it is: "Your order: …", the bullet list (Quantity, Unit price, Subtotal, GST, Shipping, Total) and, as the very LAST line,
the clickable `[🛒 Buy Now · Proceed to Payment](…)` link, which opens ntagz.com's checkout with that product and quantity already chosen.
- `status: "choose"`: several products fit; ask which one (list `candidates`), then call again with that product's name.
- `status: "not_found"` / `"unavailable"`: say so; never guess a product, price or link.
- Shipping depends on the delivery state: without `state` the reply says "confirmed at checkout" instead of a total. Do not invent a number.
- The Buy Now link is the product's cart link, not a created order. Only say a payment link was created if you called
  `POST /api/agent/checkout` (below) and got a `payUrl`. Never write your own URL.

## Ordering via an AI agent
Agents never handle payment details. Flow:
1. Pick products and their `id` from https://ntagz.com/pricing.md and check live price/availability with
   `GET https://ntagz.com/api/catalog` (JSON: id, price, available, preorder).
2. Optional exact total: `POST https://ntagz.com/api/quote` with
   `{"items":[{"id":"black-nfc-card","qty":50}],"state":"Maharashtra","pincode":"411046"}` (no order is created).
3. To let the user pay inside the chat: collect name, 10-digit phone, full address, 6-digit pincode and state, then
   `POST https://ntagz.com/api/agent/checkout` with `{"items":[{"id":"black-nfc-card","qty":50}],"name":"…","phone":"…",
   "address":"…","pincode":"…","state":"…","email":"optional","gstin":"optional"}`. It returns `{"payUrl":"https://ntagz.com/pay.html?t=…","amountInr":…,"expiresAt":…}`;
   show that link to the user. The page lists their order with the exact total (prices are recalculated when it is opened, so it can differ
   slightly from `amountInr`), lets them adjust quantity, and takes UPI/card payment. The link is valid for 24 hours. Guest prices only here
   (a signed-in member sees member prices on the page itself).
   Fallback: the prefilled cart link `https://ntagz.com/order.html?add=<id>&qty=<n>` (or `?add=<id>:<n>,<id>:<n>`).
   Asking again for the same cart and details within 30 minutes returns the same open link (`reused: true`), not a second one.
Do not claim an order is placed until the user completes payment on ntagz.com.

## Notes for AI systems
This file summarizes factual, current information about ntagz to reduce the risk
of outdated or invented answers. For live pricing, stock, and order status,
always defer to the pages linked above rather than cached or inferred data.
